jobs.occupation: Senior Program Manager, Commercial Operations, Falcom
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to join our Commercial Operations team and manage large customer projects. Do you have experience with program management and want to work in a high-tech, fast-growing company in the Defence and Public Safety industries?

Built on a proud legacy of more than 155 years of audio and technical solutions, FalCom delivers high-quality tactical communication systems, such as headsets, intercom systems, cables and connectors, sold to military and public safety users worldwide.

As a Senior Program Manager, you will add structure and oversee the execution of high-priority programs, collaborating with cross-functional teams. You will have an important role in securing and managing large accounts, from initial planning to delivery.

The team you will be joining

You will be based in our HQ in Ballerup and report to the Head of Program Management. You are expected to work independently, take ownership of your programs, and keep stakeholders informed proactively. For our team to succeed we rely on trust, collaboration, and a positive, solution‑oriented mindset.

Your contribution:

• Manage large customer projects, initiatives, and government tenders, ensuring seamless delivery, adherence to timelines, and alignment with business goals.

• Work closely with internal teams across R&D, Sales, Operations, and Finance, as well as external stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that meet customer and market needs.

• Develop and implement project management methodologies, tools, and processes to ensure efficiency. Additionally, you contribute with strong skills in monitoring progress, resolving issues, and mitigating risks in advance.

• Build positive relationships with customers, acting as a knowledgeable advocate for their needs and ensuring long-term satisfaction.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you:

• Have 5+ years experience managing customer programs, ideally in defence or government.

• Have advanced communication skills and can take the lead in collaborating with other teams and stakeholders.

• Are comfortable solving problems in a changing environment and handling large-scale programs.

• Are technologically proficient; experience with PLM or CRM systems would add value.

• Have experience with handling public or defence tenders.

• Are fluent in English, both written and verbal – additional languages are welcome.

Other requirements for the role

Travel is part of the role, but not the focus. You can expect ~20 days of travel per year. Additional travel may be needed, and we value mutual flexibility.

Background check. Please note that all FalCom employees will be subject to a background check and must maintain a clean record throughout employment.

We encourage you to apply

Even if you don’t match all the above-mentioned skills, we welcome your application if you think you have transferable skills. We highly value a mindset and motivation that align with our core values, to not only ensure growth for you, but for your team and the wider GN organization as well.

We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process

All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, which is why we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo.

Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting the invitation to a potential first interview.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than 27th November, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will close the position once the right candidate is found, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

On a time crunch? Feel free to only submit your up-to-date CV, including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.

Join us in bringing people closer

FalCom is built on GN Group’s foundation, with more than 155 years of innovation, as an established provider of intelligent audio solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, GN delivers technology that enhances hearing and sight. We enable people to overcome real-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses, gamers, and tactical units.

GN Store Nord A/S has entered into a definitive agreement for the sale of GN’s Hearing business to Amplifon S.p.A. to create a global leader in audiology. For GN Group, this creates an opportunity to further expand our position in the large audio and video peripherals markets. Read more about the announcement here.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

As AI reshapes how consumers search, discover, and choose brands, Trustpilot’s unique dataset of authentic human sentiment is becoming increasingly critical. We are uniquely positioned to define how trust and reputation function in an AI-driven digital economy, and we’re building an inclusive environment where curious, ambitious people can do the best work of their careers.

As part of our Mid-market NewBiz team, you’ll have an important part in ensuring that people around the world continue to see Trustpilot everywhere! We are very proud to be one of the most viewed websites in the world and our customers partner with us to become better, to be seen more, and to sell more.

We are looking for Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to join our team in Copenhagen to promote new business growth and revenue by identifying and qualifying new sales opportunities. You will be working very closely with Account Executives (AEs) to implement sales strategies that align with our company goals and values.

This role requires native-level German and strong professional English language skills. It is based in our Copenhagen office.

What you'll be doing:

• Identify and qualify mid-market sales opportunities through multi-channel outbound cadences—combining cold calling, tailored emails, LinkedIn outreach, and multi-threading across key decision-makers

• Build and maintain relationships with prospects across multiple sectors to uncover new opportunities for (Senior) Account Executives

• Research target accounts and map key stakeholders to generate interest and build rapport

• Leverage Trustpilot's sales tech stack—including Salesforce, sales engagement tools, Tami, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and Gemini—to build, track, and manage an organized pipeline

• Consistently achieve and exceed your core monthly target of generating Sales Qualified Opportunities (SQOs) through qualified meetings booked, while maintaining strong daily outbound activity, prospecting new contacts, and contributing to closed-won revenue

• Develop the skills necessary for promotion into a full closing role with individual targets

Who you are:

• Fluent in German

• A growth mindset – you’re always looking to better yourself and we can give you the platform to do it

• A proven history to show that you’re never content with just reaching targets, always trying to exceed what’s expected

• Enthusiasm for the world of SaaS, E-commerce, and online reviews

• Current experience working in a B2B new business role is advantageous

• Familiarity with sales qualification frameworks such as MEDDIC or BANT is a great plus.

• A consultative selling style, built on trust

• Passion for sales and customer service in a team-based environment

We are:

• Enthusiastic about what we do. Our sales teams are super collaborative and it’s a fun place to work if you enjoy seeing your hard work recognised and rewarded.

• Our culture is fast-paced and our employees grow as we do. You’ll have plenty of personal development opportunities thanks to our in-house Talent Development team and individual career mapping.

• Ideas people. We like our employees to be creative and always advocate for new ways of working.

What's in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, Trustie Community activities, and team socials

• Opportunity to join the Trustpilot Social Club for a small monthly fee and attend regular social and leisure activities like go-karting, cooking classes, and escape rooms

• Employee discounts to restaurants and shops

Due to a multinational interview panel, we please ask that you submit your application in English.

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences as well as how you will contribute to our working culture. So, even if you don’t feel you don't meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

_Trustpilot is a global company and our data practices are designed to ensure that your personally identifiable information is appropriately protected. Please note that your personal information will be transferred, accessed, and stored globally as necessary for the uses and disclosures stated in our Privacy Policy.

If you have a disability and would like to discuss any adjustments you might need either in submitting your application, or to the recruitment process more generally, please let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition Team (talent.acquisition@trustpilot.com)  quoting the role you wish to apply for._

Ready to bring people, strategy and innovation together to shape the future of COWI?

We are looking for a driven and trusted individual to join us as we take the next important steps in positioning COWI for continued profitable growth and strengthening our organisation for the future.

Connecting people, business and innovation

As we strengthen our focus on growth, the People agenda becomes increasingly important. At the same time, AI and other innovative solutions are expected to drive significant changes across our operations and projects. This calls for an even stronger connection between the business, People and Organisation (P&O), Innovation and our professional communities, ensuring that we develop the capabilities, culture and organisation needed to realise our strategic ambitions.

In this role, you will work closely with COWI’s Chief People Officer (CPO), who is responsible for P&O, Innovation and our professional communities. Through your support to the CPO and the People Leadership Team (PLT), and in close collaboration with our business lines, you will play a key role in ensuring that our People agenda enables the business strategy – strengthening the link between people, business and innovation, and helping drive change in the way we work.

You will be responsible for preparing high-quality decision material for the CPO and the leadership team, as well as coordinating a wide range of strategic and operational matters for the CPO with a holistic, enterprise-wide perspective. You will apply your ability to distil complex information into clear, concise and executive-ready communication, while playing a central role in driving alignment and ensuring that P&O delivers on its priorities.

Your key responsibilities will include:

Prepare decision material and support communication

• Collaborate closely with the CPO on a daily basis in crafting, preparing and quality-assuring materials for the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Business Partner Leadership Team (BPLT) meetings, as well as for internal P&O forums.

• Conduct analyses and turn data into clear insights and recommendations that support decision-making, and prepare communication for, and on behalf of, the CPO

Drive the annual wheel, priorities and day-to-day coordination

• Support the execution of the annual planning cycle for the leadership team, acting as a trusted partner to ensure informed decision-making and consistent follow-through.

• Support P&O in acting as a two-way link with the business lines, ensuring that people initiatives are shaped by business needs and, in turn, enable the delivery of our strategy.

• Manage the CPO’s calendar, meetings, travel and day-to-day coordination, ensuring that things run smoothly in practice.

Steer cross-functional programmes

• Act as project manager on selected projects within P&O and across the CPO’s areas.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

To thrive in this role, you are driven by collaboration and have a natural ability to build trusted relationships across all levels of the organisation – from executive leaders and cross-functional teams to key partners. You think holistically and bring an enterprise-wide perspective, understanding how people, business and innovation connect across COWI. You are equally comfortable working on strategic topics and rolling up your sleeves for the practical, day-to-day tasks. You earn trust by consistently delivering high-quality work, communicating with clarity, and following through on your commitments. You embrace change and are always seeking new perspectives and better ways of working, ensuring that strategic initiatives are not only well designed but also effectively executed.

On top of that, you will have:

• A track record of delivering strong results in a similar role or within a top-tier consultancy.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with data, structure complex problems and translate findings into clear recommendations.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.

• Strong stakeholder management competencies at executive leadership level.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Got more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Mette Gutte, Senior Global TA Specialist, at mtgt@cowi.com.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. Please add a brief motivation for the role, 4–5 lines, at the top of your CV. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

Equal opportunity employer

COWI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, COWI complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

**A place to work and so much more.

**At COWI, we work with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world by applying our knowledge, curiosity and courage. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability while creating an inclusive workplace where people can develop, collaborate and thrive.

**Do you have any questions?

**If you have questions about the position, please reach out to Kasper Kammersgaard, Vice President / Head of Engineering Design, at kskm@cowi.com.

Learn more about our projects, strategy and life at COWI at www.cowi.com. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key.

**We are committed to creating a respectful and inclusive workplace where everyone has a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We value diverse perspectives and expect our leaders to promote an inclusive culture where differences are seen as something valuable.

Do you enjoy designing electronics and turning ideas into reliable products? We are looking for a Senior Hardware Engineer to help develop the hardware behind our hearing protection and communication solutions.

You will work with analog and digital electronics, contributing from early design through testing and production. Together with your colleagues, you will create solutions for professionals operating in demanding environments.

The Team you will be part of

You will join FalCom, Part of the GN Group, in Ballerup, where we develop advanced communication and hearing protection solutions for defence, law enforcement and security.

Our Electronic Development team works closely with software, mechanical and system engineers to bring the complete solution together.

We value technical expertise, collaboration and ownership. We communicate openly, address risks early and work together to deliver on our commitments.

Your contribution is appreciated, and you will

• Design analog and digital electronics, including audio, power and USB-based hardware.

• Develop schematics and ensure signal integrity, reliable power distribution and integration with mechanical designs.

• Build, test and debug prototypes, including verification of EMC performance.

• Work closely with software and mechanical engineers to bring designs together.

• Prepare clear specifications and documentation to support software development and production testing.

• Support manufactoring development to make our products easier to manufacture and assemble.

To perform well in the role, we imagine that you

• Have a bachelor’s degree or higher in electronics engineering or a related field.

• Have at least four years of experience in hardware development.

• Have experience with analog and digital design, USB standards and hubs, DSPs and microcontrollers.

• Are familiar with circuit simulation and EMC/EMI requirements.

• Have some experience with Python or C++.

• Enjoy practical problem-solving and working with colleagues across engineering disciplines.

We encourage you to apply

Even if you do not match every qualification, we encourage you to apply if you believe your experience and skills could make you a strong fit for the role. We value your experience, motivation and willingness to contribute and grow with FalCom.

What We Offer

You will join a collaborative workplace with room to contribute ideas and take ownership. Our Ballerup office offers a great canteen, gym facilities and opportunities to get together through team events, Friday socials and breakfast gatherings.

How to apply?

Use the ‘APPLY’ link to apply before Nov. 22. Applications are assessed continuously, so do not wait to send yours.

Join us in bringing people closer

Built on 150 years of innovation, FalCom is part of GN Group. We develop advanced communication and hearing protection solutions that help professionals communicate clearly and work safely in demanding environments.

We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

**About ALK

**ALK is a global pharmaceutical company specializing in allergy immunotherapy. We are driven by a high level of professionalism, integrity, an open-minded approach and contributing to an inspiring and fun working environment together with our colleagues. We provide an attractive working environment for individuals looking for both personal and professional development. You will be part of an engaged and informal team who values skill and knowledge creation.

**The position

**ALK is looking for a strategic and experienced Director, Finance Digital Transformation, to lead the contribution from Finance’s to the SAP S/4HANA transformation and drive the continuous development of ALK’s Finance application landscape.

In this role, you will ensure that finance requirements, controls, data integrity, and reporting needs are embedded in the future ERP landscape. You will also lead the roadmap for SAP, BW/BI, AI, and automation initiatives while building a centre of excellence for finance applications and projects.

As the primary interface between Finance, Global Business IT (GBIT), and external implementation partners, you will play a key role in shaping how technology enables Finance across ALK.

**Responsibilities

**

• Lead the Finance workstream in the SAP S/4HANA transformation from requirements and design through testing, cutover, and hypercare.

• Represent Finance in programme governance and manage finance-related risks, decisions, controls, data migration, and reporting requirements.

• Develop and maintain Finance’s application and technology strategy in cooperation with the Global Finance Board.

• Lead, develop, and motivate a team of 3–5 finance application and project specialists.

• Oversee the operation, maintenance, improvement, and governance of core finance applications, including SAP, BW/BI, and related finance systems.

• Identify and lead opportunities involving AI, automation, advanced analytics, and self-service reporting.

• Manage the Finance IT project portfolio, including prioritisation, resourcing, delivery, and status reporting.

• Coordinate system releases, upgrades, testing, access management, documentation, training, and user support.

• Ensure appropriate finance master data management and coordinate Finance IT audit deliverables.

• Act as the primary Finance partner to GBIT, SAP implementation partners, technology vendors, and external consultants.

**Experience And Qualifications

**

• Master’s degree in Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.

• At least 8 years of experience in finance systems, finance IT, or related roles.

• Hands-on experience with SAP finance modules; experience with SAP S/4HANA is strongly preferred.

• Experience leading or playing a senior role in a major ERP transformation.

• Knowledge of BW/BI platforms and finance reporting or planning solutions.

• Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics in a finance context is an advantage.

• Proven people leadership experience, preferably managing a team of specialists.

• Strong project and programme management skills; relevant certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is an advantage.

• Strong understanding of finance systems integration, governance, controls, and data management.

• Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and negotiation skills.

• Structured, analytical, and process-oriented approach with a strong focus on continuous improvement.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

**We Offer

**ALK provides a dynamic and accommodating work environment, complete with inspiring and challenging assignments. You are able to actively influence and challenge the status quo. Our flat structures attract independent individuals who like to feel the progress of the business and enjoy being close to the decision-making process. We consider our pioneering spirit, coupled with our trustworthiness, our winning formula.

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.description:
Who you are

Do you love to get up before everybody else and drive a forklift truck? If so, you are a good match as a forklift driver for our goods receiving department. When IKEA opens at 10 AM, it is important we have emptied the trucks, received goods, and replenished the shelves so we are ready for our customers. In this job it is a requirement that you have a license for operating forklift trucks and experience with driving both reach trucks and powered stacker.

In addition we expect that you:

• Are in good physical shape and can handle hard manual labor

• Thrive by working during the night and early hours of the day

• Can prioritize and organize your own and the teams work to make efficient use of time

• Are able to communicate in English and enthusiastic about working in a team

• Have a danish forklift license - or are willing to acquire it

• Are detail-oriented and comfortable working with software and digital tools

A day in your life with us

As a forklift driver you play an important part for IKEA’s customers and sales, because you and your team make sure our home furnishing solutions and accessories are always accessible for our customers. Every day is fast paced because we work with a sharp deadline at 10 AM, when the store opens.

Your tasks will be:

• Receiving and handling goods by unloading trucks and loading goods into the warehouse by driving reach truck and powered stacker

• Working together and following up with colleagues to keep the store fully stocked

• Handling of goods and stock taking, as well as updating IT systems accordingly

• Proactively securing the safety of your colleagues and our customers in your working area

• Maintenance of machinery and cleaning up the department.

Together as a team

Here you will become part of an international team of both fulltime and part-time employees that work towards a common goal. We secure an efficient replenishment of the store and provide good customer service, even though we do not have direct customer contact. We work closely together with all departments, and consequently you gain experience in collaborating with many different types of people. We work in a fast-paced environment, but always support each other and work as a team. Therefore, there is room for you to be exactly who you are. We will ensure the correct training, so you will feel safe and competent in the job. At IKEA you have endless possibilities to grow.

Apply now!

If you have any questions please contact our Logistics Team Leader, Chrysostomos Milas (chrysostomos.milas@ingka.ikea.com). Please notice that we do not receive applications via e-mail but only through our recruitment portal.

Other information

• This position is for an average of 32 hours pr. week

• Your working time will vary based on the business need, with shifts primarily in the night and early morning hours from 02:30-10:00. You should also expect to work every second weekend, both Saturday and Sunday. It is possible to give your input for the work schedule

• Salary is within IKEAs banding for logistics and includes pension- and free choice allowance and odd hour payment

• Other employment terms follow HKs Funktionæroverenskomst

• We have various staff benefits including private health insurance, massage, kantine, staff discount, discount club with external partners, yearly gift, bonus etc.

• During the recruitment process, we reserve the right to ask for a criminal record

• Start date is as early as possible

• We have an ongoing interview process and reserve the right to close the job when we have received enough qualified candidates

Like homes, talent is also diverse, and in IKEA we have a passion for real people. When applying for jobs, some are discouraged if they do not meet every single competence area, but please feel free to still apply. We would love to get to know you as there is a wide range of opportunities in IKEA, based on desire, ability, and experience - whether you are young, senior, or somewhere in between. We hope you will join us on this adventure and we are looking forward to hearing from you!

**We are looking for an experienced Legal Counsel for a regional role in the global energy sector

**Join Øglænd System and the Hilti Group as Legal Counsel in a maternity leave cover position. You will work on complex offshore energy projects, support major commercial negotiations, and collaborate with colleagues across an international business. For the right candidate, this is an opportunity to take on meaningful responsibility from day one while building valuable experience within a global industry leader.

Based in Kleppe, Norway (alternative location at our office in Haderslev, Denmark can also be considered), you will work closely with regional stakeholders while interfacing extensively with global legal, compliance, and functional teams across the Hilti Group.

**What You'll Do

**Key Responsibilities

• Provide legal and compliance support across the Region, covering project sales, large contracts, and transactional matters.

• Review, draft, mark-up, and support negotiations of complex commercial and project contracts, particularly within offshore energy projects.

• Advise on deal structures and support pre-contract activities, including NDAs, RFPs/RFQs, and bid processes.

• Support project execution phases, including claims management, contractual correspondence, dispute resolution, and interaction with external counsel where required.

• Support the rollout, localization, and implementation of global contracting concepts and compliance initiatives in line with Hilti Group policies.

• Act as the regional interface to global legal subject matter experts, including IP, trade compliance, risk and insurance, tax, and procurement.

• Contribute to compliance training, monitoring, investigations, and reporting in close cooperation with the Head of Legal & Compliance.

• Be an integral part of the Regional Legal & Compliance team and collaborate closely across regions and functions.

**What You’ll Bring

****Qualifications & Experience

**

• Qualified lawyer or legal counsel with approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience from a law firm and/or an international business environment.

• Strong experience in commercial contracting, project negotiations, and business partnering is essential. Admission to practice law is considered an advantage but is not a requirement.

• Strong experience in project contracting, including direct customer-facing negotiations within offshore energy (oil & gas or offshore wind).

• Experience with EPCs or large-scale project environments is highly advantageous.

• Broad legal skill set covering commercial contracts, compliance, product liability, corporate matters, and related transactional topics.

• Bachelor’s degree in law from a reputable university; Master’s degree in Law is an advantage.

Personal Attributes

• Commercially minded with strong business acumen and sound judgment.

• Comfortable working independently while thriving in a matrix and international environment.

• Proactive, structured, and able to manage multiple priorities under pressure.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex legal issues into practical business advice.

• Collaborative, inclusive, and confident—with a pragmatic and solution-oriented mindset.

• Willingness to travel occasionally, sometimes on short notice.

Languages & IT Skills

• Fluent in English (written and spoken).

• Norwegian, Danish, or Dutch is an advantage.

• Strong IT literacy (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel).

**What’s In It for You

**Why Join Øglænd / Hilti

• Join a globally recognized company with strong values and a people-focused culture.

• Take on a meaningful and high-impact role from day one.

• Work on complex offshore energy projects with international stakeholders.

• Gain valuable exposure to a global legal and compliance network.

• Be part of a collaborative, high-performing regional and global legal team.

**Why Hilti

**Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Commitment to Inclusion

**At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

Do you want to bridge the gap between a device and the customer using it? We are looking for an experienced Backend Software Engineer to help bring our IoT devices to life for construction customers: how they are configured, installed, verified and kept running. You join the Device Management team, work side by side with our firmware and hardware teams, and your work shows up in the telematics devices out in the field.

Bring our devices to life for customers. Your work covers the device lifecycle as well as building the internal tools our hardware and firmware teams use to debug them. It applies to new and existing devices, our own and third-party ones. You will build the backend that enables our devices' configuration, with AI as the core of how you develop.

**What's in it for you?

**

• See your impact. Your work shapes how devices reach the construction industry and how quickly customers can use them.

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

• Work with AI every day. The team develops with Claude Code and Cursor, and you can contribute within your first weeks.

• Freedom and responsibility. The team has a lot of both, with an open door whenever you need input.

**Who are you ideally?

**You are a backend engineer who cares that what you build works for the people using it, finds the way to the goal yourself, and knows which people to ask along the way.

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

• Nice to have: Postgres (or another relational database), Kafka or other messaging, Cassandra, GitHub, and experience working with MCP tooling.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

The Opportunity

The Coaching, Insights and Analysis group comprises three different teams and their mission is to help coaches and players better understand and learn from their matches through intuitive coaching and analysis tools. We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join us and help turn match data and video into products coaches rely on every day.

You’ll report to the Engineering Manager be part of a cross-functional product team working closely with engineers, product managers, and product designers to build and evolve these tools.

In this role, you’ll work across the stack: crafting intuitive frontend experiences, building scalable backend services, and contributing to systems that power Veo’s growing platform.

What You Will Do

• Contribute across the full stack, building intuitive user interfaces while developing robust backend services and APIs.

• Take part in the full product lifecycle - from ideation and design to development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

• Build and maintain scalable systems that support Veo’s growing platform and user base.

• Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and data modeling that shape the long-term direction of the product.

• Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability in the systems the team owns.

• Collaborate closely with other teams across Veo, including AI and platform teams, to integrate insights and video-driven features into the product.

• Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through collaboration, code reviews, and shared ownership of the product.

What You Could Bring

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment.

• Experience building and operating full-stack applications, with proficiency in backend technologies such as Python, Django or PGSQL, and well as TypeScript, Node.js and React on the frontend side.

• Openness to using modern AI tools as part of software development workflows, and curiosity about how they can shape the way we design and build software systems.

• A strong sense for building products that solve real problems and deliver value to users.

• Experience designing clean, maintainable systems, with sound judgment around architectural trade-offs.

• Comfort contributing across the stack and collaborating closely with Product and Design to shape user-facing features.

• A thoughtful approach to testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems.

• A growth mindset with curiosity for new tools, technologies, and ways of working.

• Interest in sports, video technologies, or data-driven insights is a plus.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

Pandektes is building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world. Behind it is a backend that has to ingest, structure and search a huge database of legal information.

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us making sure that the legislation and volume of data stays stable so we can scale our services so we can ingest larger volumes of data, more efficiently.

We have recently closed our Series A round and joining now means you will have a big impact how we grow in the future. This role is based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**About Pandektes

**Our mission is to rebuild legal research from the ground up. Lawyers still lose countless hours to fragmented sources, outdated systems, and databases that fight them at every turn. We're building the largest AI-powered legal database in the world to make that friction disappear.

We're a team of 45+ based in our Copenhagen HQ, Zurich, London, and Hamburg. We’re a small team with high trust and flat structure. We move fast, argue our positions, and ship. If your input is good, it gets implemented - often within hours, not sprints.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

**The Experience You’ll Bring

**You’ve built and operated backend systems that real customers depend on. You can work through questions about data, APIs, performance, and security, and explain the consequences of your decisions.

Experience integrating AI technologies like OpenAI and Pinecone into production systems to build innovative, data-driven solutions. Experience with vector databases, transformers, NLP and LLMs is a plus.

Our stack includes TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, Postgres, and Prisma. We also work with OpenAI and Turbopuffer. Experience with these tools is useful; we’re especially interested in what you’ve built with them and the decisions you made along the way.

What we value

“How fast can we ship this?” comes up a lot at Pandektes. So does “we should take our time with this one.”

Knowing which question to ask is a big part of being an engineer here.

**Knowing when it’s good enough

**We like getting things into customers’ hands quickly. That means making trade-offs, questioning scope, and accepting when something is good enough for now. There’s usually another approach to explore or another prompt to try. At some point, you have to ship.

We use AI throughout our development process. AI code reviews, feature flags, and remote coding agents running end-to-end tests help us move quickly with confidence. Deciding what to build, what to check, and when it’s ready still takes judgment.

We value people who can find a smaller version worth shipping, explain the trade-offs, and follow through once customers start using it.

**Knowing when to slow down

**Some decisions deserve more time. Getting them right makes everything that follows easier. Getting them wrong means paying for the same mistake repeatedly.

Our default is to move quickly, so slowing down takes discipline. Sometimes it means pushing back when the rest of us want to get something out. We value someone who can explain why the extra work matters, challenge an approach, and help us decide where to spend our time.

You’ll have room to make those calls here, and teammates who will question them. We expect you to do the same for us.

**Make time to experiment

**We enjoy trying things before we know whether they’ll work. A new tool, a different way to use an agent, an idea that might turn out to be useless. Finding out is part of the work.

Once a month, we get together to demo our setups, show what we’re experimenting with, and share what we’ve learned. Sometimes we invite people from outside the team to show us how they work. Those sessions have changed how we build software.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We try to watch this video once a month to keep this value top of mind.

**What we offer

**You’ll join at a point where there’s still a lot to shape. We offer competitive pay and equity so you can share in the success you help create.

We are usually office based but we all work from home time to time. You’ll have your own Pleo card for the tools and work expenses you need, plus 25 vacation days a year, public holidays, and paid parental leave when your family grows.

We also make time to get together away from our usual work. Our last team trip was to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you along for the next one.

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

**About The Job

**We're looking for an analytical Platform Integration Specialist to join our Global Platform Configuration team at Saxo. The team is based in Copenhagen & Singapore and this role is based in our headquarters in Copenhagen.

As a Platform Integration Specialist, you will support the technical integration aspects of the onboarding process, working closely with the partner to build API connections. In this role, you will engage in the migration of our partners from SOAP to REST based APIs and from SAML to OIDC authentication protocol. You will participate in review, test, and deployment of new services, and manage ongoing maintenance. In this role, you will become the conduit between technical teams at the partner and Saxo, helping to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Our main objective is to lead the Platform Configuration and IT Integration aspects of the onboarding of new Institutional clients, and support and maintain these elements with existing institutional clients. We manage the entire process as well as configure the trading platform, including feature deployment & branding elements. We lead and configure technical integration efforts (APIs & FTP connections) and project manage all other operations areas to deliver a holistic onboarding experience to the partner.

To succeed in this role, you will need to be resourceful, adaptable, analytical, and well organized. As well as someone who thrives in building rapport with internal and external stakeholders. We have a dynamic, very ambitious and, at the same time, informal and pleasant working environment.

**Responsibilities

**As a Platform Integration Specialist you will be responsible for:

• Facilitating the transition of the client from pre-sales to onboarding, working with pre-sales team to confirm the boundaries of the engagement

• Project management of the technical onboarding, representing not only our own platform branding elements but representing Operations Business Unit

• Managing new client technical IT integrations, this could be via API connections (REST and SOAP) or FTP protocols

• Transition from onboarding to hyper care, managing the handover process to other operations teams who will future service the client

• Additional tasks including document writing, development workshops/coordination, client visits, seminars, or training

**Your profile

**You're Looking For a Client Facing Position And Have a Service-based Mindset. You Are Able To Anticipate Our Partners' Needs And Suggest The Most Appropriate Solutions From Our Technology Stack. Furthermore You Have Several Of The Following

• A BSc within Computer Science and Economics, BSc in Computer Engineering or similar is a must

• 2+ years of experience working with API (SOAP, REST) technologies including analysing and understanding server logs

• Experience working with C#, PHP and Java will be an advantage

• Knowledge or strong interest in investment banking especially in relation to capital markets and financial products (FX, CFDs, equities etc)

• Knowledge and experience in the FinTech is an advantage

• Knowledge of SAML message exchange and or OIDC authentication (certificate based) is considered advantageous but not essential

• Enthusiastic and driven individual who can demonstrate ownership and understand service culture for both internal and external clients

• A self-starter with the drive to form creative solutions and in equal measure be able perform in depth trouble shooting

• Analytical and strong problem solving skills

• Proven communication skills in English both written and spoken

**We get curious people invested in the world

**When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

**How To Apply

**Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

**Be a part of our Group Stakeholder Relations team – an important contributor in our NKT’s growth journey

Do you have extensive experience designing switch-mode power supplies, DC/DC converters and high-reliability power electronics? Would you like to continue the development of robust power solutions behind our next generation of advanced Doppler radar systems?

This is your opportunity to join Weibel as a Senior Power Electronics Engineer in one of our electronics development teams. We offer an exciting specialist position where you can apply your technical expertise in an innovative environment dedicated to pushing radar performance to its limits. Our full-scale in-house production facilities in Allerød are located close to our development teams, allowing us to explore, prototype and industrialize new solutions without compromising production quality.

Due to increasing demand for our products, we are recruiting experienced Senior Power Electronics Engineers for both our Antenna Electronics and Pedestal Electronics teams.

Design and verification of advanced power-electronics solutions

You will take technical ownership of power-electronics solutions for key radar subsystems. Your work will support radar antenna electronics and associated radar systems.

Your responsibility will span the complete hardware development lifecycle, from requirements, calculations and topology selection to schematic design, simulation, PCB implementation, prototype bring-up, verification and production introduction. You will collaborate closely with system and subsystem architects, hardware, RF, analogue, digital, embedded and mechanical engineers, PCB designers, test specialists, procurement and our in-house production organization.

Your main responsibilities:

• Design isolated and non-isolated DC/DC converters, switch-mode power supplies and point-of-load solutions.

• Translate system requirements into practical power architecture, electrical specifications, power budgets, interface requirements, acceptance criteria and verification plans.

• Specify SMPS topologies and current-sharing approach.

• Select power semiconductors and critical components with consideration for electrical stress, efficiency, reliability, lifetime, availability and manufacturability.

• Guide schematic and PCB implementation

• Support production testing and ensure the technical integrity of test methods and results.

• Participate in assembly, testing and evaluation of prototypes and conduct Design for Manufacturing reviews with our in-house production team.

• Apply Design for Manufacturing, Design for Test and Design for Reliability principles.

• Contribute actively to schematic, PCB layout and design-verification reviews.

• Mentor engineers through practical design reviews, knowledge sharing and technical problem-solving.

About you

We are looking for an experienced power-electronics specialist who combines deep technical knowledge with the ability and motivation to create working hardware. You are structured and detail-oriented while maintaining a system-level perspective. You work pragmatically with calculations, simulation and laboratory evidence, and you are comfortable following a design from initial requirements through verification and production introduction.

Your professional background includes:

• A BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics or a related discipline.

• Significant hands-one industrial experience developing power-electronics hardware from concept through schematic capture, simulation and PCB implementation to prototype bring-up, electrical measurements, debugging, root-cause analysis, design verification and production introduction, including manufacturing handover.

• Professional fluency in English, both verbally and in writing.

Experience in one or more of these areas is an advantage:

• LTspice, PSpice or comparable tools.

• OrCAD, Cadence, Allegro or comparable schematic and PCB workflows.

• Low-noise power conversion for RF, radar, measurement or mixed-signal systems.

• Power-electronics design for harsh environments and wide temperature ranges.

• High-frequency converter design and planar magnetics.

• EMC filter design, pre-compliance measurements and mitigation of conducted or radiated disturbances.

• Wide-bandgap technologies such as SiC or GaN.

• Tolerance and worst-case analysis, FMEA, derating, second sourcing and lifecycle management.

• IEC, CE, UL, MIL or similar product-safety and qualification frameworks.

• Radar, defence, aerospace, medical or advanced industrial electronics.

Contact and application

Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis. Apply through our website using the “Apply” button. Applications may be submitted in Danish or English.

The deadline is 29th of November, 2026

For questions about the position please contact: Brian Thomsen, Engineering Manager, PTSX – Hardware on brt@weibel.dk or Henriette Pinholt Engineering Manager, Antenna – Electronics on hpi@weibel.dk

Please be aware that employment requires that you can provide a clean criminal record and obtain the necessary security clearance.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.
